_comment: aterm PATHOLOGICAL-BENCH baseline: per-corpus median MB/s of Terminal::process under hostile input (yes-flood / escape-storm / style-churn / long-escapes / wide-unicode). Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record pathological. Each corpus fails independently iff measured < recorded * pass_ratio. Recorded 2026-07-08 on the M2 Air (dev box) — conservative for the faster bench machines; re-record on m3/m4 only with the machine idle.
